{{Quote|Well, I'm sorry, Jan, but my ancient Rakatan is just a little rusty. So if I'm going to get this temple door open before that... whatever that is comes over here and has us for lunch, I need a few minutes!|Levat, to Janese|<ref name="ETU" />}}
A '''temple''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Levat]] believed that temple was constructed after the fall of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], despite the presence of the [[Rakatan writing system|Rakatan]] script, speculating that the temple was built by the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] or one of [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] colonies from [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]].<ref name="ETU" />
